# go doc with @version on a standard library package must be
# rejected, not silently fall back to the current standard library
# documentation. The period-splitting loop in parseArgs must not
# drop a version error by reloading the package without a version.
# See golang/go#81670.

! go doc encoding/json@go1.19.0
stderr 'argument must not be a package in the standard library'
! stdout .

! go doc encoding/json/v2@go1.19.0
stderr 'argument must not be a package in the standard library'
! stdout .

# The same must hold for the pkg.Symbol@version form, which is also
# handled by the period-splitting loop: it must fail instead of
# showing documentation for the current version of the package.
! go doc encoding/json.Marshal@go1.19.0
stderr .
! stdout .

! go doc encoding/json/v2.Marshal@go1.19.0
stderr .
! stdout .

# And for the two-argument form with a versioned package.
! go doc encoding/json@go1.19.0 Marshal
stderr 'argument must not be a package in the standard library'
! stdout .
